label: Walmart
description: Arcade.dev LLM tools for searching for products sold by Walmart

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: Item ID. E.g. '414600577'. This can be retrieved from the search results of the SearchProducts tool.

tools.name: SearchProducts

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Keywords to search for. E.g. 'apple iphone' or 'samsung galaxy'

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort the results by the specified criteria. Defaults to 'relevance_according_to_keywords_searched'.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Minimum price to filter the results by. E.g. 100.00. Defaults to no minimum price.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Maximum price to filter the results by. E.g. 100.00. Defaults to no maximum price.

parameters.name: next_day_delivery
parameters.description: Filters products that are eligible for next day delivery. Defaults to False (returns all products, regardless of delivery status).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results to return (1-50). Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip before the first returned item. Defaults to 0.

output.description: List of Walmart products matching the search query.

summary:
## Walmart Toolkit

The Walmart toolkit connects Arcade to Walmart's product catalog via SerpAPI, enabling LLMs to search for products and retrieve product details programmatically.

## Capabilities

- **Product search**: Query Walmart's catalog by keyword and paginate results using `has_more` / `next_offset` (note: `total_count` is not available — SerpAPI does not expose it)
- **Product detail retrieval**: Fetch structured details for a specific Walmart product by identifier

## Secrets

- `SERP_API_KEY` — A SerpAPI API key used to authenticate all requests to SerpAPI's Walmart search endpoint. Obtain it by creating an account at [SerpAPI](https://serpapi.com/), then navigating to your [dashboard](https://serpapi.com/dashboard) where your private API key is displayed. Free-tier accounts include a limited monthly search quota; paid plans are required for higher volume. No special scopes or permissions beyond account ownership are needed — the key grants access to all SerpAPI endpoints your plan supports.

See [Arcade secrets configuration](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets) for how to store and reference secrets, or manage them directly at https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets.
